title: Meal Prepping 101: Chicken Tortilla Soup
seo_title: Meal Prepping 101: Chicken Tortilla Soup Workshop
description: A hands-on meal prep class where Chef Zach guides each guest through making their own four-quart batch of made-from-scratch chicken tortilla soup. You learn practical techniques for building layers of flavor and preparing fresh ingredients to make home cooking easier and more efficient. Each guest leaves with four quarts of soup and a take-home recipe.
